name: Lenses
description: Configures the parallel-lens dispatch SWE uses when TPM runs Review Mode or Planning Mode.

reviewLenses.label: Review Mode Lenses
reviewLenses.description: Comma-separated list of review lenses. SWE-1 runs the first, SWE-2 the second, etc. See the keyword table below for available lenses.

planningLenses.label: Planning Mode Lenses
planningLenses.description: Comma-separated list of planning lenses. Each becomes one SWE producing a plan fragment. See the keyword table below for available lenses.

autoKickReviewOnColleagueBranch.label: Auto-Kick Review On Colleague Branch
autoKickReviewOnColleagueBranch.description: When on, TPM auto-starts Review Mode at session start if every commit on the branch was authored by someone else. Off requires manually requesting Review Mode. Default off.

autoKickPlanningOnFreshBranch.label: Auto-Kick Planning On Fresh Branch
autoKickPlanningOnFreshBranch.description: When on, TPM auto-starts Planning Mode at session start if the branch has zero commits ahead of its base. Off requires manually requesting Planning Mode. Default off.

triggerBaseBranch.label: Trigger Base Branch
triggerBaseBranch.description: Base branch the planning trigger compares against for commit count (e.g. main, master, develop). No effect when Auto-Kick Planning On Fresh Branch is off.

mixedAuthorBehavior.label: Mixed Author Behavior
mixedAuthorBehavior.description: How the review trigger handles a branch with mixed authorship. ask (default): confirms with the user. skip: treats it as author-mode. kick: starts Review Mode immediately.
